remarks: Welcome to Schooner Cove, a beautifully landscaped waterfront community with a private marina in the Shippan area of Stamford. This classy ground-floor unit with gorgeous LVT floors throughout has been tastefully and stylishly updated. The kitchen showcases stainless steel appliances, under cabinet lighting and quartz countertops, and flows effortlessly into the dining area and spacious living room. The living area, with a cozy wood-burning fireplace and ceiling to floor windows is an inviting place for relaxing and entertaining. A dry bar and automated window shades are a wonderful addition to this space. A slider door from here to a private patio is also a wonderful spot for morning coffee or head out and stroll over to your very own boat dock (#A11, for a 26ft boat). The main level boasts a generous sized bedroom with a private and renovated ensuite bath, along with a convenient half bath and laundry facilities. Upstairs, there is an additional bedroom with another ensuite bathroom. Residents of Schooner Cove can also enjoy a gated swimming pool with toilets and picnic tables. With heat, water, snow removal and landscaping covered by the association, you'll enjoy a hassle-free waterfront living experience. It's a short walk from here to restaurants, bars, public beaches, sporting fields, and beautiful parks and minutes to Stamford train station and I95. What more could you need or want? Move right in!
